tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: The accent: links, the dot before 'Deprogramming', active states, the lead story's tag. From the logo gradient (dark stop in light theme, light stop in dark). 6.3:1 on surface (light), 7.6:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: brand-green-deep
tokens.usage: Logo gradient dark stop. Large fills and video backgrounds' accent bands in both themes; white text on it is 6.8:1.

tokens.name: brand-green-bright
tokens.usage: Logo gradient light stop. Rules, progress bars and accent shapes on cinema-black; never as text on light surfaces (2.4:1); 7.8:1 on cinema-black.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: The warm neutral in the logo mark. Sparingly: kicker labels and hairlines on cinema-black (9.9:1 there); not for text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: signal-magenta
tokens.usage: PROPOSED thumbnail outline colour (experiment, see Thumbnail). Only as the outline on promo thumbnails and the Shorts frame border; never text, never UI. Chosen to be unmistakably different from Secular Talk's green outline.

tokens.name: cinema-black
tokens.usage: Video and thumbnail ground in both themes. Pair with caption-ink, parchment, brand-green-bright.

tokens.name: caption-ink
tokens.usage: Titles, captions and lower-third text on cinema-black or on footage under the caption plate.

tokens.name: caption-plate
tokens.usage: Translucent plate behind captions and lower thirds so caption-ink stays above 4.5:1 on any footage.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Web page background (deprogrammer.org/network).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form panels, the sort switch's active pill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised (17:1 / 17:1).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: intro line, channel names on cards. On surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Meta text (times, counts, help). On surface: 5.3:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card outlines on the web page. Decorative only (not a 3:1 control border).

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Category chips and the sort switch track.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on brand-green fills (tags, buttons): 6.8:1 light, 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, offset 2px; above 3:1 on every surface.

families.serif: "Iowan Old Style", Charter, "Sitka Text", Cambria, Georgia, serif

styles.name: thumb-headline
styles.usage: Thumbnail headline at 1280x720, uppercase, 2-4 words per line, max 2 lines.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Opening title cards and chapter cards at 1920x1080.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Small uppercase label above titles, in parchment or brand-green-bright.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Three courts ruled against the plan this week.
styles.usage: Burned-in captions at 1920x1080 (60px on Shorts), caption-ink on caption-plate, max 2 lines, 42 characters per line.

styles.name: lower-third
styles.usage: Channel name in lower thirds; the video title under it uses caption at 30px weight 500.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Section headings on the web page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The independent voices, legal analysts and newsrooms worth your time, in one place.
styles.usage: Web body copy and YouTube description text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Counts, timestamps, help text, in muted.

styles.name: page-wordmark
styles.usage: The page name next to the logo in the web top bar only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: meta separators.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Avatar-to-text in cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter; card body gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on the web page.

tokens.name: safe-margin
tokens.usage: Video title-safe margin at 1920x1080 (5%); keep all text inside it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Focus rings, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Video thumbnails and channel tiles on the web page.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The lead story, the suggest panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, buttons.
